label: VFD BL302 OPCUA TwinCAT v2
info: Dashboard y servidor OPC UA en BL302. TwinCAT recibe consignas por Ethernet y controla COM7 hacia el PLC Delta. Este flujo no utiliza puertos seriales Linux ni nodos Modbus en el BL302.

name: ARQUITECTURA: Web → BL302/Node-RED → OPC UA/TCP → TwinCAT PC → COM7 → PLC Delta → RS485 → VFD
info: Antes de desplegar, deshabilite el servidor OPC UA anterior que utilice el puerto 53881. Mantenga el motor detenido durante las pruebas.

name: No existe /dev/ttyUSB0 en esta arquitectura. COM7 pertenece al PC Windows y será atendido por TwinCAT.

name: Validar orden recibida desde la web
Modelo de estado del dashboard
func:
const s = flow.get("vfdState") || {};
const hz = Number.isFinite(Number(s.frequencySetpointHz)) ? Number(s.frequencySetpointHz) : 0;
const raw = Number.isFinite(Number(s.frequencyRaw)) ? Number(s.frequencyRaw) : 0;

const uiState = {
    frequencySetpointHz: hz,
    frequencyRaw: raw,
    motorCommand: Number(s.motorCommand || 5),
    requestedState: s.requestedState || "STOPPED",
    commandSequence: Number(s.commandSequence || 0),
    commandValid: s.commandValid !== false,
    webHeartbeat: Number(s.webHeartbeat || 0),
    webOnline: s.webOnline !== false,
    twinCATOnline: Boolean(s.twinCATOnline),
    twinCATSession: s.twinCATSession || "NO_SESSION",
    plcFrequencyRawAck: Number(s.plcFrequencyRawAck || 0),
    plcCommandAck: Number(s.plcCommandAck || 5),
    vfdRunning: Boolean(s.vfdRunning),
    vfdFault: Boolean(s.vfdFault),
    vfdStatusText: s.vfdStatusText || "NO_FEEDBACK",
    lastWriteOk: Boolean(s.lastWriteOk),
    lastWriteStatus: s.lastWriteStatus || "WAITING_TWINCAT",
    lastWriteTimestamp: s.lastWriteTimestamp || "NONE",
    lastWebAction: s.lastWebAction || "NONE",
    lastWebUpdate: s.lastWebUpdate || "NONE",
    serverStatus: s.serverStatus || "INITIALIZING",
    endpoint: s.endpoint || "opc.tcp://172.28.76.226:53881/UA/VFDGateway"
};

return [
    { payload: { uiState: uiState } },
    { topic: "Frecuencia comandada", payload: hz }
];
